panels.description: A crumpled, grease-stained sheet shows a crude pencil pump-bracket sketch with fingerprints and no patent number. Keep it unobstructed.

Alex’s daughter studies the drawing while Alex stands beside her. Reserve isolated upper-left space for the daughter’s balloon and separate lower-right space for Alex’s reply; keep both faces and the drawing clear.
The daughter beams at the drawing. Leave the upper third open for lettering.
Alex looks from the grease-marked sketch down to Adrian’s old steel wristwatch on his left wrist, thumb covering the watch face. Leave upper-left open.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: And the one I'm most proud of. It helped a lot of people.

items.speaker: DAUGHTER
items.text: That looks like a lot of fun!
